resources.string: Write a card
01 / CONNECT THE READER
Put a memory card of 8 to 256 GB in a USB card reader, then connect the reader to this phone.
Find the reader
02 / CHOOSE THE READER
Choose your card reader. Your phone then asks whether DeKoi may use it.
USB card reader
No card reader found. Check that it is connected to this phone.
Look again
Reading the card…
03 / ERASE THIS CARD

Everything on this card will be erased. Your phone then downloads Raspberry Pi OS, %1$s, so Wi-Fi is best, and writes it to the card with your DeKoi’s settings. This can take half an hour; you can use other apps meanwhile.
Erase this card
04 / WRITE THE CARD
Downloading
Writing
Checking
Done
%1$s of %2$s
Keep the reader connected until the card is ready.
05 / LINK THE CARD
The card is ready. Linking it to your account…
The card is ready, but it is not linked to your account yet.
You can also link it later: go to Add a DeKoi and type this code.
06 / POWER ON
%1$s is linked to your account.
Put the memory card in your DeKoi.
Connect your DeKoi to your router with a network cable.
Connect the power. Your DeKoi sets itself up and appears in the app within a few minutes.
Done
THE CARD IS NOT READY
There is no card in the reader. Put the card in and try again.
The reader holds more than one card. Leave only the card you want to write in it.
DeKoi may not use the reader. Try again and allow it when your phone asks.
This card holds %1$s. Use a memory card of 8 to 256 GB.
The card is locked. Slide the small switch on its side up, then try again.
The download stopped. Check your internet connection and try again.
The download arrived damaged, so the card was not finished. Try again.
The card stopped responding. Check that the reader is connected and try again.
The card did not keep what was written. Try another card.
Memory card for your DeKoi
Writing the card. Keep the reader connected.
The card is ready. Open DeKoi to link it.
The card is not ready. Open DeKoi to see why.
